executive_summary: The customs authority adopted a new requirement for electronic clearance documents. Market A regulator published a proposal to change the approval process for corporate repatriation payments. Market B central bank announced that its policy rate increased by 50 basis points. Port Delta authority confirmed that cargo handling has resumed. The planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours. The port authority has now confirmed that cargo handling has resumed. The shipping bulletin reported bunker fuel at 600 USD per tonne. It also reported a freight rate of 1200 USD per TEU. Port Delta authority announced a planned strike lasting 24 hours. MPA and CCS signed an agreement covering green shipping. The same agreement also covers digitization of maritime services.
